claim_boundary: The accumulated cuts state exactly that no certificate of the menu closes the profile, so UNSAT is the chart-level theorem: every fixed-U-admissible profile of this form admits a tame covering menu, hence by Theorem 1 a complete EFX allocation within the edge budget in every physical realization.  It is a theorem about the declared exact-response chart and this move family, not about four-agent EFX.  SAT reports an admissible profile that no whole-role and no tame one-split family closes; since a wild role is never split, such a profile is open rather than refuted.
